QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Rise from Ruins
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2142001##k, in #bHenesys Ruins#k, wants to speak with you.

0.0: Life has returned to town, thanks to you. Of course, it's not over yet. There are still many remnants of the Knights, and the monsters are always unpredictable. But at least we now have hope.

no.0: Please don't say no. It's not that big of a gift.

0.1: With hope, the people can rise again. Henesys is in ruins right now, but we'll rebuild it. All of us together will make that happen.
0.2: As the town's representative, I want to give you a small gift as a show of appreciation. Will you accept it?

1.0: It's not much, but it comes from all of us. You're a hero to this town. We'll never forget what you did for us.
